# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 86 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 86 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_086_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 3

**1** I saw a tall man come and call the virgins, walking around the tower and examining it very carefully. He passed a rod to the virgins and they began to strike the tower with it. **2** And the tower shook all over, and the parts that were not sound fell away. But the good parts remained firm. **3** And I marveled when I saw the tower shaken, for it was made of such glorious stones. **4** And he said to me, "Do not be troubled; for the tower is shaken in order that those who are unsound may fall away, and those who are sound may remain." **5** Then the tall man said to the virgins, "Remove from the tower any stones that are not sound, and give them to the builders." And those stones that had been removed were found to be various; some were round, smooth, and polished, not fitting into the tower; and others were cracked; and others were rough; and others white and round, not fitting for the building. **6** And I saw the virgins take away some of the stones from the tower and lay them aside. Then they went to the gate and brought other stones from there to fit them in. **7** But others were not taken from the gate, but remained by the roadside. And all who had put them there took them back. **8** And he said to me, "Those stones which were removed from the tower and placed by the roadside — you see these round ones. If they do not repent, they shall not find a place in the building; but if they repent and are found worthy, they shall be built into the tower; and if they do not repent, they shall be replaced by others, and these shall be utterly cast out." **9** And when I had seen all this, the shepherd said to me, "Come, let us walk away a little, and when the virgins have finished the tower, I will explain to you the meaning of all this." **10** Then I departed a short distance with him, and the virgins completed the rest of the building.

---

*EMET: the shaking of the tower is the testing/purification of the church. The round stones cannot fit because roundness (worldliness, compromise) makes them unable to join the square tower.*
